displayName: Billing detached — the whole project is down

documentation.content:
The billing kill switch detached the billing account from `keplaria`. **Everything stops when this happens**, including the judge-facing hosted path, and it does not recover on its own.

This is deliberate — it is the hard spend cap doing its job — but the blast radius is the entire project, so it needs a human immediately.

**Recover:** re-attach the billing account in the Cloud console (Billing → Link a billing account). Nothing else restores service. Then find out what spent the money before re-arming, because the cap will simply fire again.

See `infra/billing-killswitch/` for the function and `spikes/cost_posture/` for the measured burn rate it is guarding against.
